dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible along the dorsal ridge; edges exhibit high-contrast, jagged perimeters with a sharp gradient transition from light cream exterior borders to dark charcoal internal regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, asymmetrical clusters of solid high-intensity white/cream pixels concentrated primarily on the mid-dorsal spine and scattered sparsely across the lateral flanks.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent macro-annuli form a distorted trapezoidal geometric relationship extending from the upper neck region to the mid-posterior section.

other_distinctive_markers: A highly intricate, interconnected reticulated web-like pattern of thin, high-contrast linear filaments connects the larger annular structures across the central dorsal field.
